fields.label: Main group
fields.note: POST body field. Values are the main groups the site publishes (records also carry SubGroup/Department); the /CareerApplicantApi/Career/Groups resource lists them.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Location is a per-job field (hc_Location / category 'location'); the search body only carries the India-wide scope flag isAllIndia (3 = all India), so city narrowing is local.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Published on each job page as 'Job type'; no request field for it, so local filter only.

notes: https://www.icicicareers.com/ redirects to the bank's own SPA at https://careers.icici.bank.in/CareerApplicant/Career/job-listing/ (the HTML is a 1.4 KB shell with no form, so every control is drawn by the React app). Listing and search go through a POST to https://careers.icici.bank.in/CareerApplicantApi/Career/Search/<page> whose JSON body is AES-encrypted by the site's own transform and is {userId, ApplicantId, keyword, maingroup, experience, PageNo, limit, isAllIndia}. Confirmed machine-usable fields are keyword (free text), maingroup (department) and experience; isAllIndia is a scope flag (3 = all India) rather than a city filter. Paging is PageNo with limit=12. No sort control was found.
